P. O. REG
No. 532
Date 25/8/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
24th August 1916.

Sir,
The rebel leader Han Hwe 韓恢 is trying to arrange to hold a memorial service in Chang Su Ho gardens on 5th proximo in honour of a rebel named Zee Chi Yung 徐企文 who was executed in Peking in 1913. Zee was the leader of the Chinese Labour party. It is said that the memorial service will be the initial step towards the revival of this party, and that Han Hwe will become its leader.

Mr. Tsang Nyoh Ling 張玉麟 who has come here to represent the Central Government on the occasion of General Yang's birthday, visited Woosung yesterday. He had a long conversation with Deputy Military Governor Lu, who appears to be quite loyal to the Central Government.

Four field guns made in 1914 were sent to Nanking from the Arsenal on 23rd instant.

Your obedient servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
532
S. I. S.
P. O. REG
第 532 号
日期 1916年8月25日
上海工部局。
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）
1916年8月24日。

先生：
叛乱首领韩恢（Han Hwe）正试图安排于下月5日在张叔和花园举行纪念仪式，以悼念1913年在北京被处决的名为徐企文（Zee Chi Yung）的叛乱分子。徐曾任中国劳工党领袖。据称，此次纪念活动将是复兴该党的第一步，而韩恢将成为其领袖。

张玉麟（Tsang Nyoh Ling）先生此次前来代表中央政府参加杨将军的寿辰庆典，他昨日访问了吴淞。他与护军使卢副使进行了长谈，卢副使似乎对中央政府相当忠诚。

兵工厂于本月23日向南京发送了四门1914年制造的野战炮。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

警务处总监上尉
